description: A meeting's machine transcript alone, each turn led by its timestamp linked to the video, windowed by `start` and `max_chars` (default 60,000), with a pointer to continue.

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

meeting.description: The meeting: its address (2026-02-05/house-rules), the General Assembly's video id or URL, or a body and a date (House Rules 2/5/2026).
meeting.title: Meeting

start.description: Where to start, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the beginning.
start.title: Start

name: meetings_get_transcript
title: Read a meeting's transcript
